1  THIS REVIEW PETITION FILED UNDER SECTION 114 READ  WITH ORDER 47 OF CPC, PRAYING TO CALL FOR THE RECORDS OF  MFA NO.23208/2012 (LAC).

AND TO REVIEW AND SET ASIDE THE  JUDGMENT AND ORDER PASSED IN MFA NO.23208/2012 LAC  PASSED BY THE HON'BLE COURT ON 05.12.2019. CONSEQUENTLY,
 IT IS HUMBLY PRAYED TO ENHANCE THE COMPENSATION OF  ACQUIRED LAND BEARING RS NO. 75/1A, MEASURING 3A-15Gs,
 SITUATED AT HALLUR VILLAGE IN BAGALKOT TO RS.30 LAKHS PER  ACRE WITH INTEREST AND SOLATIUM UNDER VARIOUS HEADS AS  PRESCRIBED UNDER THE ACT IN THE INTEREST OF JUSTICE, EQUITY  AND CONSCIENCE.
 -2-  NC: 2024:KHC-D:3508-DB  RP No. 100017 of 2020  THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
S G PANDIT, J., MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER
Learned counsel for respondent No.2 Sri B.S.Kamate is present.
Learned counsel for the petitioner is absent.
On the earlier occasion also i.e., 31.01.2024 there was no representation for the petitioner.
Till date, the office objections are not complied with.
Hence, the petition is dismissed for non-compliance of office objections/non- prosecution.

Sd/-
JUDGE Sd/-
